key.name: show-offline-nodes
key.description: List devices that are not currently reachable. Turning this off shortens the device list on a tailnet with many machines that are usually asleep.

key.name: show-mullvad
key.description: Include Mullvad's exit nodes, grouped by country, in the exit node list. A tailnet with Mullvad enabled gains several thousand of them.

key.name: max-menu-height
key.description: An upper bound on the menu height, in logical pixels. Zero means the menu may use whatever room the monitor's work area leaves below it, which is the default and is almost always what you want.

key.name: open-menu
key.description: Open the quick settings menu with QuickTS expanded.
